goal: On first retry-budget exhaustion the re-driver auto-escalates exactly once (a stronger-model / re-decompose attempt) instead of terminating the task, and on a second exhaustion routes it to the human-review queue with reason=retries-exhausted-after-escalation rather than a silent terminal FAILED.

relevant: packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/harness.py -- the exhaustion walk to terminal FAILED (~1786-1810) and is_retry_eligible; the seam where exhaustion is observed
packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/lifecycle.py -- consecutive_failed_runs() (~257), computed but unused today; the signal escalation builds on
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_orchestrate.py -- the orchestrator seam that drives the escalated attempt and routes to the queue surface
references: .flywheel/specs/00069-FEATURE-work-redriver.md -- criteria #5, #6, #13; Decision D-A; D-C (escalation under the budget)
constraints: Escalate exactly ONCE on first exhaustion (a stronger model OR a re-decompose attempt, reusing existing model/decompose configuration); on a SECOND exhaustion route to the queue with reason=retries-exhausted-after-escalation (criteria #5, #6)
The escalation must itself be bounded -- never re-escalate on every exhaustion (criterion #13); the escalated attempt runs under the existing per-run budget ceilings (D-C)
Re-eligibility is requested through sanctioned store/claim APIs; the harness owns transitions -- do NOT make core impure and do NOT forge a status or agent envelope
Commit the change with a clear message before reporting done
non_goals: Do not modify files under packages/*/tests/; do not weaken or delete assertions
Do not weaken the core purity tests; do not design a new escalation-policy engine -- only select stronger-model/re-decompose from existing config
edge_cases: After the first exhaustion the task is NOT in terminal FAILED -- an escalated attempt is observably dispatched
An exhausted-after-escalation task must be queryable in the queue; it must never be recorded as a bare silent terminal FAILED with no queue entry
